ADPCM codecs: MS, IMA-WAV, IMA-QT decoders plus encoders.

Decoders port symphonia-codec-adpcm (codec_ms.rs, codec_ima_wav.rs, codec_ima_qt.rs, common*.rs): tables and block layouts verbatim. Output is sfS32 with 16-bit samples MSB-aligned (sample << 16), exactly like the reference.

Nibble order differs per codec: MS emits upper-then-lower, both IMA variants lower-then-upper.

Encoders (encodeMs*, encodeIma*) are new work: Symphonia has no encoders. They are closed-loop (analysis-by-synthesis): each nibble is chosen by running the exact decoder step for all candidates and keeping the minimum-absolute-error reconstruction. MS tries all 7 predictors per block and keeps the best.
